documentLibrary.value: Mobile-first fitness tracker and preset plan app. All theme tokens, GlobalStyle, and styled components are inline. All data is loaded from the inline CMS database (db.json). Includes fitness tracker, nutrition tracker, preset workout plans, exercise library, and affiliate promotion.
